english: Walpurgis Night is celebrated on the last of April.
tip: Huge bonfires and singing welcome spring – especially popular among students.

target: Semlan är en favorit i februari.
english: The semla is a favorite in February.
tip: Semlor (cream-filled buns) are traditionally eaten before Lent, now available January-March.

target: SFI erbjuder gratis svenska för invandrare nästa år.
english: SFI offers free Swedish for immigrants next year.
tip: Swedish for Immigrants – a comprehensive integration program.

target: Jantelagen säger att man inte ska tro att man är bättre.
english: The Law of Jante says you shouldn't think you're better.
tip: Jantelagen is the unspoken social code against boasting – deeply embedded in Nordic culture.

english: The principle of public access provides transparency.
tip: Sweden's transparency principle makes most government documents public.

english: Pea soup is served on Thursdays.
tip: Ärtsoppa on Thursdays is an old Swedish military tradition still kept alive.

english: The People's Home shaped twentieth century politics.
tip: "Folkhemmet" is the social democratic vision that built modern Sweden.

english: Cozy Friday means tacos and TV.
tip: Fredagsmys is a uniquely Swedish tradition – relaxing on Friday with comfort food.

english: The frog dance at midsummer is mandatory.
tip: Children and adults hop like frogs around the maypole – delightfully silly.

english: The Nobel Prize is awarded in December.
tip: The Nobel Prize ceremony takes place at Stockholm Concert Hall on December 10th.

english: The house was painted in Falu red paint.
tip: Falu rödfärg is the iconic red paint from Falun copper mine, used since the 1600s.

target: Samisk kultur innefattar renskötsel och jojk.
english: Sami culture includes reindeer herding and joik.
tip: Joik is a traditional Sami form of singing – deeply spiritual and cultural.

target: Dalahästen är en symbol för Sverige.
english: The Dala horse is a symbol of Sweden.
tip: Hand-painted wooden horses from Dalarna – iconic Swedish folk art.

target: Personnumret är centralt i svensk vardag.
english: The personal ID number is central in Swedish daily life.
tip: Every resident gets a personnummer – used for healthcare, banking, everything.

target: Ombudsman är ett svenskt ord som spridits.
english: Ombudsman is a Swedish word that has spread.
tip: One of few Swedish words used internationally.

target: Stuglivet är en del av den svenska identiteten.
english: Cabin life is part of Swedish identity.
tip: Many Swedes have a sommarstuga (summer cabin) in the countryside.
Take a number, wait your turn – cutting in line is a serious social offense.

target: Sjuksköterskan mätte patientens blodtryck och puls.
english: The nurse measured the patient's blood pressure and pulse.
tip: "På håret" = by a hair – just barely.
